column1: # immunarch::repOverlap() values for five toy repertoire pairs, measured once and
# committed, because immunarch lives only in the image recorded below, which the
# pipeline does not run, and the unit suite runs in a plain R with no container.
# This is what discharges the claim in
# are the same quantities as repOverlap(.method = "jaccard") and
#              (the .simg name is the md5 of that URL, which is how Snakemake
#              names its image cache. The pipeline does not run this image;
#              the digest is recorded so these frozen values stay traceable.)
# Regenerate with, from the module root:
#     rep <- function(k, n) data.frame(CDR3.nt = k, CDR3.aa = k, Clones = n,
#       Proportion = n / sum(n), V.name = "V1", J.name = "J1", D.name = "D1")
# Each row is one unordered pair. keys_* and counts_* are comma-separated and
# aligned; jaccard and morisita are repOverlap's answers, written with %.17g so
